_readme: Per-account templates and posting rules. Lives on the VPS at
/opt/fiesta/bot/accounts.config.json and is re-read every 60s, so edits take
effect on the next cycle with no deploy and no restart.
role:  main_reply = posts its own template on a lead
url_drop   = posts the short website comment after a main reply
share: relative weight when picking which main_reply account replies
counted from replies_log so they survive restarts.
